accepted_subset.definition: Total-company cash and cash equivalents plus current marketable or short-term securities.
accepted_subset.acceptance_rule: Instant USD facts only; same-accession component sums; earliest public filing for each point; row visibility begins at SEC acceptanceDateTime.

deferred.total_debt: Current/noncurrent and inclusive total tags are not uniformly used; requires entity-specific taxonomy paths and scope reconciliation.
deferred.contractual_purchase_obligations: Tags and disclosed scope are not sufficiently comparable across all four issuers.
deferred.quarterly_capex_and_operating_cash_flow: Duration facts are commonly YTD; quarter-only derivation and restatement rules must be implemented before promotion.

rejection_policy: reject duration or YTD contexts for the stock feature
reject components from different accessions or filing dates
do not apply a filing before its SEC acceptance timestamp
require append-only review for amended or restated values
expire carried values after three months
